requirements.social_connections: Studio must connect to X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, Bluesky, Threads, Pinterest, Discord, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, GitHub and email through a SOCIAL_CONNECTIONS registry with OAuth/webhook steps, status, read-only default and no stored secrets.
requirements.byte_exact_reverse: Every reverse-engineering task must sweep the artifact byte by byte: record total bytes and sha256, account for every range with a finding or an unknown carrying its offset, require 100% coverage before closing the gap, and back claims with offset/hash/observed output plus a differential replay. Never silently skip data; never bypass DRM.
requirements.team_not_picker: The AI workers must be one collaborative team, not a list of individually selectable agents. Members have roles, work at the same time on the same task, and pass information to each other through a shared message bus / workspace, like a real company.
team_behaviour: No member picker in the UI: the person enters a task and the right member(s) are selected automatically, with a visible reason
More than one member is active by default; a single member only for genuinely single-role tasks, decided automatically
Orchestrator decomposes a task and assigns roles; several members work concurrently
Shared message channel and task board visible in the UI; members post findings and hand off artefacts
Each role has goals, permissions and a status (working, waiting, done)
Human authorisation given once, then remembered; approvals are not re-requested every action
Auto mode supports hours, days, weeks, months, years and non-stop
Progress reports can be sent to email or a chat webhook
No subscription, credits or paid feature gates anywhere
requirements.current_gap: app/src/studio.js currently implements a pick-one-agent list with integrations and scheduling; it does not run a collaborative team with inter-agent messaging.

lessons: A process named ChatGPT.exe can be the Codex MSIX package (OpenAI.Codex). Check the path, not the name.
Working set is not commit. 'ollama app' showed 21 MB WS but held 3.6 GB of commit.
Never run Select-String -SimpleMatch with a regex: it silently matches nothing.
Stopping Ollama to free RAM breaks Hermes when its provider is 127.0.0.1:11434. Start it on demand first.
A 4B model with no chat template is not an agent model, regardless of parameter count.
Craft Anything's builder gives up after repeated provider timeouts; 15 quiet minutes is a dead run, not slow work.
A free cloud model that supports tool calls beats a local model on an 8 GB CPU laptop; stepfun/step-3.7-flash:free and opencode/hy4-flash-free both work without credits.
Not every free model supports tools; verify with a tool-call probe before making it the builder.
